purpose: Prevent selection bias by counting explicit documentary relation edges whether target support is known, mixed, or unspecified, and by separating direct/declared derivative relations from source-family and similarity relations.

relation_strength.A1_RECIPROCAL_EXPLICIT: source and target mutually identify original/translation/summary/copy relation
relation_strength.A2_UNILATERAL_EXPLICIT: one catalogue entry explicitly identifies the other as original or derivative, but reciprocal wording is absent/not yet checked
relation_strength.B_SOURCE_FAMILY: catalogue explicitly links multiple source documents to a synthesis/summary but not one-to-one descent
relation_strength.C_RELATED_OR_SIMILAR: see also/similar/can be compared; excluded from direct denominator

denominator_rules: Never drop target-support-unspecified edges from the total explicit-relation denominator.
Report known-support coverage before reporting switch/continuity proportions.
Keep Tier B source-family relations separate from Tier A direct/declared edges.
Exclude Tier C similar/related references from direct transformation counts.
Use volume+folio+content+relation phrase as primary relation locator; item number is a versioned catalogue field.
Do not infer machine paper from pre-bound notebook form.
